description: Quotes the equity subscription plans for a company's cap table. Read-only. When required is false there is no fee in this environment and nothing to collect. Company intake can finish without payment. paid only records that a payment was once confirmed; it never proves current access, so read equity_onboarding_get_subscription_access for that. Read the offered plans before asking the owner to choose a billing period, then use equity_onboarding_get_payment_link to return a Stripe link. Never ask for card details or claim that quoting a plan pays it.
name: equity_onboarding_get_fee
title: Get Equity Onboarding Fee
